You and I are well aware that there's a lot at stake in this election — too much to keep track of. We call the candidates in these races our Democracy Defenders , because, if elected, they will be key firewalls against Republicans’ anti-democracy efforts across the country. These candidates are running for a variety of roles: governor, state legislator, supreme court justice, and more. body:

Peter,
I’m about to ask you to **[chip in $10 to support my re-election here in Maryland.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260817-3.Ys0N01&refcode=em-20260817-3&t=2&akid=1768%2E1086043%2E9cXKpp)** But first, let me tell you why.
Our campaign's next deadline is quickly approaching, and after tomorrow night, everyone will be watching our fundraising numbers.
National Republicans are looking for any sign that our campaign is vulnerable. They want to flood this race with money, flip Maryland red, and roll back our progress.
I want our fundraising report to send a clear message: _**Maryland is not for sale to the highest bidder.**_
**[This campaign depends on grassroots supporters like you chipping in what they can a few dollars at a time. body:
What is happening to America?
What is happening to America?

| | | | Fellow American, What in the world is happening to America? There was a time when Zohran Mamdani's radical ideas were making daily headlines: **_State-run grocery stores_**** _Tax the middle class out of the city_**** _ Calling for replacing police officers with social workers_**** ** Red-blooded Americans will look at that list with utter disgust. ** ** Abdul El-Sayed, on the other hand, saw everything Mamdani did, and decided to say... _ "Hold my beer." _ El-Sayed is making Mamdani look like child's play: **_Endorsed by the Muslim Brotherhood_** **_Publicly defended Sharia Law_**** _Wants a system of "public control" of companies (also known as _communism_)_****_Ban 4th of July fireworks and football_**** _ _** And now, we have James Talarico here in Texas of all places who rails against God, Christianity, free market capitalism, and the Constitution. 10 years ago, someone with these views would never have stood a chance - let alone in _Texas!_ But not today... **There is a real possibility that El-Sayed and Talarico will serve in the Senate - and they'll have SIX YEARS to do irreparable damage to our country.** The _America_ you and I know and love is on the ballot this November. Every value we hold is on the chopping block in the midterm elections. **We 're in the final stretch of the election - and our GOP candidates really need your help overcoming massive fundraising deficits.**** ** **If you can, will you please split a contribution that will automatically provide critical last-minute resources to Ken Paxton and Mike Rogers - who are running to defeat Talarico and El-Sayed? body:
Judicial Watch announced that it filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Justice for the contents of Anthony Fauci’s government-issued cell phones. The phones were provided to former National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) Director Fauci and later reportedly recovered by the FBI (Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Justice (No. 1:26-cv-02812)).

Dear Peter, The choices we make today shape the Oregon future generations will inherit. As someone who has already invested in protecting Oregon's environment, you've helped safeguard the forests, wildlife, clean air and water, and healthy communities that make this state so special. This **Make a Will Month** , I invite you to consider one more way to ensure that legacy continues for generations to come. Whether it's a favorite hiking trail, a quiet stretch of coastline, or the forests and rivers that make Oregon home, the places we love connect us across generations. A planned gift helps ensure that future generations inherit the same natural beauty—and that there will always be advocates fighting to protect Oregon's environment and climate.

[**Make the pledge to include OLCV or OLCV Education Fund in your will or estate plan.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137420485/640749132/1838085064?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ2MjM2NjI0LWEwOWEtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMGQzYTExZmEzMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=lD0P5n8Xm2joSaO-LYYoDubcQs6DLRGLlHy-jZfzWFY=&emci=0b5b556c-8d9a-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=d6236624-a09a-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=2107230) A legacy gift is one of the most powerful ways you can invest in Oregon's future. Your generosity will help ensure there are champions fighting for clean air and water, climate action, and leaders who will protect our environment for years to come. **For many supporters, a legacy gift is a way to ensure the values that have guided their lives continue to make a difference for generations to come.** There are many ways to make a planned gift and it can be simpler than you think. You can include OLCV or the OLCV Education Fund in your will or revocable trust, or name us as a beneficiary of a retirement account, life insurance policy, bank or brokerage account, certificate of deposit, or donor advised fund. If you have questions about legacy giving or would simply like to talk through your options, I'd be happy to help, but please always contact your lawyer or financial advisor to guide you through this process. If you've already included OLCV in your estate plans—or if you plan to—we'd love to hear from you. Letting us know allows us to thank you, honor your wishes, and better plan for the future.

Science, Not BS

---
| | | **[Demand Trump Rescind"Insane" Vaccine Order](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8d84fe9f-d971-4a48-b71e-d0c4c035cc4f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Donald Trump and RFK Jr. spent years [pushing anti-vaccine BS](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td4f12bb4-d0e0-48b3-bd4c-80315c2bc2eb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). And a lot of people believed them, didn’t get vaccinated, and helped bring back some horrors we’d just about wiped out. (Welcome back measles!) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb79065ba-5d4e-4943-abfb-4bfd9bce11a2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) But now these jackasses have made things even worse. Trump has signed an executive order bringing this anti-vaccine nonsense directly into federal vaccine policy -- and forcing steps that morons support, but actual scientists and epidemiologists do not, including splitting up the MMR vaccine and reducing the number of universally recommended vaccines. **Meaning more kids could get sick—and some could die from preventable diseases.** [**Add your name: Demand that Trump rescind his insane vaccine order.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T30fa4da2-7b7d-445b-b444-311c1cccebee/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) And now even a Republican senator who is also a doctor has finally found his balls and is sounding the alarm. **Sen. Bill Cassidy called Trump’s approach “a stupid thing to do,” said there is “no evidence whatsoever” that vaccines cause autism, and warned that forcing families into more shots and more doctor visits could mean fewer children get fully vaccinated.** When even batshit-insane (or cowardly) Republicans think Trump is going too far, you know there’s a there there. [**Add your name: Demand that Trump rescind his insane vaccine order.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcfa405b4-09bb-4281-8a2f-4cbefa4fb4c7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
WE NEED TO GET OUR MESSAGE IN FRONT OF MORE VOTERS.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/2TGW70RuZvX?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
| | Hello Peter,

Dr. Enoch’s campaign is moving across Ohio’s 8th Congressional District — **knocking doors, meeting voters, attending community events, organizing volunteers, and building the grassroots operation we need to compete.** Now we need your help with the next critical phase:

# WE NEED TO GET OUR MESSAGE IN FRONT OF MORE VOTERS.
With Election Day getting closer, we need to dramatically increase our visibility across the district. That means investing in **large campaign signs in high-traffic locations and digital advertising that reaches voters where they spend their time online.** And we need the resources to do it.
## CAN YOU HELP US FUND THE NEXT PHASE OF THIS CAMPAIGN?
Every contribution helps us communicate with more voters.A contribution can help us:
* Purchase **large-format campaign signs** for high-visibility locations throughout OH-8
* Expand our **digital advertising** to reach targeted voters across the district
* Produce and distribute campaign literature
* Support canvassing, phone banking and voter outreach
* Promote upcoming events and opportunities for voters to meet Dr. Enoch

**We cannot afford to be invisible.**
Our opponent has the advantages of incumbency, name recognition, and an established fundraising network. We are building something different: **a grassroots campaign powered by people who believe Ohio's 8th Congressional District deserves better representation.**

### [Will you invest $25, $50, $100, $250 — or whatever you can afford — to help us get our message out?](https://us.list-manage.com/1CKpvpszjq8?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)

**DONATE TODAY:**
[ https://enochforcongress.com/donate-now/](https://us.list-manage.com/18ryuRT_Foc?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)If you've already contributed, **thank you.** Your support is helping keep this campaign moving.
And if you can give again, this is an important time to do it.
* * *

[](https://us.list-manage.com/szsGkcXfbz3?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
# YARD SIGNS ARE IN!

We've heard from supporters across the district who want to show their support — and **our Vanessa Enoch for Congress yard signs have arrived!**
Putting a sign in your yard may seem like a small thing, but visibility matters.A yard sign tells your neighbors:
**There is a campaign happening. There is an alternative. There is a choice.**
### Request your FREE yard sign here:

[https://enochforcongress.com/product/free-yard-sign/](https://us.list-manage.com/IpDQe_wgapy?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
After you request yours, encourage a neighbor, friend or family member in the district to request one too.
**Let's make support for this campaign visible throughout OH-8.**
* * *
[****](https://us.list-manage.com/oKl7VClDNEB?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
# COME MEET DR. ENOCH
We also have several opportunities coming up to meet Dr. Vanessa Enoch, talk about the issues, and get involved in the campaign.
## FROM CONVERSATION TO CONGRESS
### Meet & Greet Reception
**Tuesday, August 25, 2026**
**6:30 PM – 8:00 PM****Hummus & Pita**
7334 Tylers Corner Dr.
West Chester, OH 45069This is an opportunity for real conversation about the issues affecting our families and communities — and the solutions we need from Washington.**Real Conversations. Real Solutions. Real Impact.****RSVP:**
[https://campaignhq.app/rsvp/hummusandpita](https://us.list-manage.com/__5U_E4CC0I?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
* * *
[****](https://us.list-manage.com/nFjhcP1o6Pq?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
## MEET THE CANDIDATE
### Major Minor Books and Such
**Thursday, August 27**
**7:00 PM – 8:30 PM**
_Doors open at 6:45 PM_**Major Minor Books and Such**
6718 Montgomery Rd.
Cincinnati, OH 45236
Come meet Dr. Enoch and hear about her priorities for Ohio's 8th Congressional District, including protecting Social Security and Medicare, lowering healthcare and prescription drug costs, strengthening veterans' services, creating jobs, expanding affordable housing, investing in American manufacturing, and holding government accountable.
Bring your questions — and bring a friend. [RSVP here](https://us.list-manage.com/av8yFIBuEn3?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8).
* * *
[](https://us.list-manage.com/6Ni5aNdBM0W?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
## CANVASS GREENHILLS WITH US!
### Canvass for Jonathan Bradner & Dr. Vanessa Enoch
**Sunday, August 30**
**2:00 PM – 5:00 PM****Drummond St. & Damon Rd.**
99 Drummond Street
Greenhills, Ohio
The Cincinnati Working Families Party Wolf Pack is organizing a [canvass covering **Greenhills A, B and C. RSVP on Mobilize here.**](https://us.list-manage.com/12tQnzElVng?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
No canvassing experience is necessary. **Training will be provided.**
Bring a fully charged phone, comfortable walking shoes, and a friend.
* * *
# WE HAVE A LOT OF WORK TO DO — AND NOT A LOT OF TIME.
This campaign is growing.People are volunteering.People are requesting signs.People are attending events.People are knocking doors.And voters are beginning to hear our message.
**Now we need to scale.**
That requires resources.When you contribute to this campaign, you aren't simply making a donation. **You're helping us communicate with voters who may otherwise never hear about this race.**
You're helping us put up the signs.You're helping us run the ads.You're helping us print the literature.You're helping us knock the doors.You're helping us build the field operation.And ultimately, **you're helping give voters in Ohio's 8th Congressional District a real choice.**

### Please make a contribution today.

**DONATE:**
[ https://enochforcongress.com/donate-now/](https://us.list-manage.com/YaRBG8ySTKT?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
**REQUEST A YARD SIGN:**
[ https://enochforcongress.com/product/free-yard-sign/](https://us.list-manage.com/CrkhbKe6gRs?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
**VOLUNTEER:**
[ https://campaignhq.app](https://us.list-manage.com/W0fTNOf7MZs?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
[Whether you can give **$10, $25, $50, $100, $250 or more** , your contribution moves us closer to the resources we need to compete.](https://us.list-manage.com/s0mE9j3fWir?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
**We can do this — but we have to do it together.** Thank you for believing in this campaign and in what we are working to build for Ohio's 8th Congressional District.
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Democratic Nominee for Congress
Ohio's 8th Congressional District
**Enough of Excuses. It's Time for Results.****Real Leadership. Real Solutions. A Stronger Ohio.**
_Paid for by the Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer._

| | | | | | It feels like nobody is running for governor right now.
Mark's hearing that [Deb Haaland's people think they're up double digits](https://us.list-manage.com/9ylN6KOub7u?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e), and from what we can tell they're acting like it. In other news, credit card delinquencies are also back where they were during the Great Recession, which matters because every midterm comes down to the economy.
---

---](https://us.list-manage.com/DlhlgBQVRGa?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | 🏛️ **HAALAND'S CAMP THINKS THEY'RE UP DOUBLE DIGITS**
Mark has been saying for weeks that a quiet race is bad news, and this one has been very quiet.
He goes through what he's hearing about the mood inside her operation, the poll she sent out to thousands of donors, and why that poll probably raised her more money than it cost her.
Gregg Hull has Sandoval County. He's running out of time to introduce himself to the other 32, and nothing about this race gets louder on its own.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/1BNw2ySOgKi?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 💰 **CREDIT CARD DELINQUENCIES ARE BACK AT GREAT RECESSION LEVELS**
The New York Fed's numbers landed Tuesday, and they're bad enough that both parties are already building 2026 campaigns around them.
Scott Jennings went on CNN with his version of how Republicans should handle it. Mark agrees with roughly half of that, and the half he doesn't is the part worth hearing.
Krysty takes it somewhere else. Her mother never carried a balance in her life, and Krysty's argument about why has almost nothing to do with Washington and everything to do with what you're holding in your hand when you pay.

📰 **THE JOURNAL HANDED THE SNAP STORY TO AN INTERN**
The tagline at the bottom says the writer is an intern with a statewide fellowship program, which is fine, except the Journal ran the piece with Stansbury and two food bank employees as the only voices in it.
Mark spent about three minutes looking and came up with six things missing from that article, including why people actually came off the rolls and a nine-figure bill that New Mexico taxpayers could end up covering. He's not blaming the intern, and he's pretty clear about who he thinks should have caught it.
🎓 **IT ISN'T THE PROFESSORS. WSJ EXPLAINS WHERE CAMPUS SOCIALISM STARTS**
Lazy rivers, buses with no fare, a dining hall where nothing has a price on it. Four years of that, then a $200,000 bill and a job market that works nothing like it.
Krysty read a good chunk of the Wall Street Journal piece out loud on the show, and there's a comparison in there about the dining hall, one kid with three plates of pasta and another with a salad, that lands a lot harder than it sounds like it should.

clean_body: Plus: Card delinquencies are back at Great Recession levels. | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com | | | | | | | | | | | | It feels like nobody is running for governor right now. Mark's hearing that , and from what we can tell they're acting like it. In other news, credit card delinquencies are also back where they were during the Great Recession, which matters because every midterm comes down to the economy. | | 🏛️ HAALAND'S CAMP THINKS THEY'RE UP DOUBLE DIGITS Mark has been saying for weeks that a quiet race is bad news, and this one has been very quiet. He goes through what he's hearing about the mood inside her operation, the poll she sent out to thousands of donors, and why that poll probably raised her more money than it cost her. Gregg Hull has Sandoval County. He's running out of time to introduce himself to the other 32, and nothing about this race gets louder on its own. | | | 💰 CREDIT CARD DELINQUENCIES ARE BACK AT GREAT RECESSION LEVELS The New York Fed's numbers landed Tuesday, and they're bad enough that both parties are already building 2026 campaigns around them. Scott Jennings went on CNN with his version of how Republicans should handle it. Mark agrees with roughly half of that, and the half he doesn't is the part worth hearing. Krysty takes it somewhere else. Her mother never carried a balance in her life, and Krysty's argument about why has almost nothing to do with Washington and everything to do with what you're holding in your hand when you pay. 📰 THE JOURNAL HANDED THE SNAP STORY TO AN INTERN The tagline at the bottom says the writer is an intern with a statewide fellowship program, which is fine, except the Journal ran the piece with Stansbury and two food bank employees as the only voices in it. Mark spent about three minutes looking and came up with six things missing from that article, including why people actually came off the rolls and a nine-figure bill that New Mexico taxpayers could end up covering. He's not blaming the intern, and he's pretty clear about who he thinks should have caught it. 🎓 IT ISN'T THE PROFESSORS. WSJ EXPLAINS WHERE CAMPUS SOCIALISM STARTS Lazy rivers, buses with no fare, a dining hall where nothing has a price on it. Four years of that, then a $200,000 bill and a job market that works nothing like it. Krysty read a good chunk of the Wall Street Journal piece out loud on the show, and there's a comparison in there about the dining hall, one kid with three plates of pasta and another with a salad, that lands a lot harder than it sounds like it should. | | | | ✅ LIKE on ✅ hit the bell ✅ FORWARD to anyone who thinks the grocery stores will just fail on their own ✅ at NoDoubtAboutItPodcast.com | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | © 2026 Choose Adventure Media. In honor of this, the U.S. celebrates National Mail Order Catalog Day today. If you're squeezing one last trip out of the summer, good news: researchers found a [short getaway can recharge you](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyhCAURb9GOxxAVrCgSGO3aVM6T3msJAg78Fyzf5_ZTP4g3a3uOXM-rvMVQgzp9g47WvJ5TnjWiERY5qPSVhAIU807pO3YIfkS3G2WXA6MGybMDCuFB84KWmc9osS-RSu00VxppUS72QtfFhDosR_HUXO59Np46UGu_QXM6NpgX3_cCCM4V5x3oBZ14ZqbYdV6EK5RHF2gXLrPHBJt6OMzP7B0a97baDeie236t0ZOjZzO8-yWZe3W3B1fjZz8QUfBRk5QKKzxtf5wgvl8FHbCszLKDL8Jk2O0IVswoQ9UWfYM2JZjcPBsi3X3M8QY6qAbxW87hPirQP8s97DyJwAA___nr4N2) just as well as a two-week odyssey. The catch is that it only works if you do one thing right, and most of us get it wrong before we even leave the driveway. _Travel Tuesday_ has the details. Before you pour the coffee, go take a look at your thermostat. Do you know why it's set to that number, or did you pick it years ago and never touch it again? You're not alone. A federal energy survey found that only 12% of American households program their thermostats to match their actual schedules. Everyone else runs one flat number all day on the single biggest expense in their power bill. clean_body: The United States' with Iran expired Monday with no peace deal in sight, and President Trump said he will not extend it. "I'm not in a hurry," he told media. | | | | | | Tuesday, August 18, 2026 ---|--- Good Morning! On this day in 1872, Aaron Montgomery Ward started what would become a 113-year business with the on a single sheet of paper. In honor of this, the U.S. celebrates National Mail Order Catalog Day today. If you're squeezing one last trip out of the summer, good news: researchers found a just as well as a two-week odyssey. The catch is that it only works if you do one thing right, and most of us get it wrong before we even leave the driveway. Travel Tuesday has the details. Before you pour the coffee, go take a look at your thermostat. Do you know why it's set to that number, or did you pick it years ago and never touch it again? You're not alone.
